snippet.title: Big Breakfast 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
I made a video game (and a video game soundtrack!) This is the trailer for the game.

In a world without Breakfast, one man decides to challenge fate! The debut RPG from Stahmpin' Grounds Studios, 
Big Breakfast 2, is an old-school turn-based RPG in the style of classic fantasy RPGs from the 8 bit era. Gather party members, gain experience, level up and learn powerful new moves as you travel the world in search of answers - and FOOD!

Wishlist Big Breakfast 2 and play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4839090/Big_Breakfast_2/
